security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Right-click AI image upscaler for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Right-click any image in Windows Explorer, pick 2K, 4K, 8K, 12K or 16K on a radial menu, and Upscalee saves an AI-upscaled copy next to the original. Fully offline and GPU accelerated (Vulkan).
